basedOn: Standard GI physiology: gastric acidification (~pH 1.5-3.5), pepsinogen -> pepsin cleavage, intrinsic-factor secretion, and macronutrient/matrix-dependent gastric emptying (teaching averages).
sources: NIDDK - Your Digestive System & How It Works: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/digestive-diseases/digestive-system-how-it-works
Hall & Hall, Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 14th ed. - Unit XII, Gastrointestinal Physiology
Boron & Boulpaep, Medical Physiology, 3rd ed. - The Gastrointestinal System

inputs.description: Available carbohydrate in the meal window
Teaching proxy for gastric acid output (PPI/age lowers it)

arrival.label: Bolus arrival via LES
arrival.detail: Chewed bolus passes the lower esophageal sphincter into the fundus; receptive relaxation lets the stomach hold volume without a pressure spike.

acidChemistry.label: Acid denaturation + peptic cleavage
acidChemistry.detail: HCl drops luminal pH (~1.5-3.5), unfolding proteins; pepsinogen -> pepsin cleaves peptide bonds. Intrinsic factor is secreted here for downstream B12 capture.

edgeCases.effect: Weak acid -> incomplete protein denaturation and reduced non-heme iron / B12 liberation.
edgeCases.note: PPI use, atrophic gastritis, aging. Teaching flag only, not a diagnosis.

emptyingControl.label: Gastric emptying rate control
emptyingControl.detail: Antral pump + pyloric gatekeeping meter chyme into the duodenum. Macronutrient mix and physical form set the rate - the single biggest lever on the downstream glycemic shape.

choices.note: Fat/protein trigger CCK & duodenal feedback -> slower, steadier release.
Liquid / refined carb empties fast -> sharp downstream appearance.

slowEmpty.label: Slowed emptying (3-5 h)
slowEmpty.detail: Higher satiety, flatter downstream glucose. Fat/protein-forward or intact-matrix meals sit longer; extraction is more complete.

fastEmpty.label: Rapid emptying (liquid / refined)
fastEmpty.detail: Low-viscosity, low-fiber load clears quickly; glucose hits the jejunum in a bolus, setting up a steeper systemic rise.

edgeCases.effect: Fast-emptying refined carb with little fiber buffer delivers glucose to the jejunum in a sharp bolus -> steeper systemic rise.
edgeCases.note: Teaching pattern only, not a score.

edgeCases.effect: Post-gastrectomy loss of the pyloric brake -> osmotic dumping; early vasomotor + late reactive-hypoglycemia teaching pattern.

mixedEmpty.label: Typical mixed-meal emptying
mixedEmpty.detail: Balanced macro mix empties over ~2-4 h; moderate downstream shape. The default path for whole, varied meals.

handoff.label: Chyme -> duodenum
handoff.detail: Acidified, partly-digested chyme is released to the duodenum, where bicarbonate neutralization and bile/pancreatic enzymes take over.
